Question
========
What is an advantage of cloud platforms?

Answerlist
----------
* structured format of data required for storing improves data quality
* scalability and flexibility
* easier search within the cloud and free access for everyone
* exceptional safety of data


Solution
========
An advantage of cloud platforms is scalability and flexibility.
